Can I apply?

Check if your Class 12 marks, subjects, and date of birth satisfy SRM’s published minimum criteria for 2026-27 admission. Evaluated instantly in your browser with zero data sent or stored.

60% aggregate in Physics, Mathematics & 1 qualifying subject
Age 16y 6m cutoff on 31 July of examination year
Admission via SRMJEEE (UG); SRM decides final selection

Built at SRM

Start-ups, engineering teams, and projects created by alumni and students of SRM.

Browse all 7 stories →
startup 4 facts
Abhinava Rizel: EV motors

Brochure says the founders are alumni of the Mechanical and Automotive departments.

“Developed electric-vehicle motors using a hybrid radial-flux design between synchronous reluctance (SynRM) and permanent-magnet synchronous (PMSM) motors.”

Read story & primary sources →
startup 4 facts
Torus Robotics: defence ground vehicles

Brochure says the founders are alumni of the Mechatronics department.

“Designs and delivers fully electric unmanned ground vehicles with a 6-degree-of-freedom robotic arm for Indian defence services.”

Read story & primary sources →
startup 4 facts
Neur Industries: AR/VR, motors and actuators

Brochure says the founders are alumni of the Mechatronics department.

“Works on AR/VR, motors and actuators; its Neur XR Studios builds enterprise XR solutions.”

Apply once, choose later

How the official SRM B.Tech admission process works.

Step 1
Check minimum criteria

Confirm at least 60% aggregate across PCM/qualifying subjects and minimum age 16y 6m.

Step 2
Single entrance application

Register for SRMJEEE (B.Tech); one application covers the campuses listed on SRM's form, including these six. Branch preferences are for statistics only.

Step 3
Select at counselling

Campus, branch, and specialisation are selected at counselling after ranks are announced.

Read complete application & entrance routes guide →
